B. 7,156,529 megawatthours

Source citation: Arkansas Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/arkansas/index.php)

Source text:
Arkansas Electricity Profile 2024

| Item | Value | Rank |

| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 15,907 | 31 |
| Electric utilities | 13,681 | 21 |
| IPP & CHP | 2,226 | 42 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 61,542,484 | 26 |
